criteria.text: Diagnosis of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, Dravet syndrome, or Tuberous Sclerosis Complex (approval criterion 2).
Patient is 1 years of age or older (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist (approval criterion 3).
Seizures have not been controlled by a trial of at least 2 antiepileptic drugs (approval criterion 4).
Patient will use as adjunctive therapy with at least one other antiepileptic drug (approval criterion 5).
Serum transaminases and bilirubin levels obtained prior to starting treatment (approval criterion 6).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Epidiolex (cannabidiol) Criteria. Version 2; Original 10/10/2018; Approval 09/18/2020; Effective 11/16/2020.

Encoded: approval criteria 1–6 shared by all three closed indications. Explicit denial criteria are covered by the inverse of these approval facts. Specialty/consultation, uncontrolled seizures after trials of at least 2 antiepileptic drugs, adjunctive use with at least one other AED, and baseline labs are attestations requiring documentation verification.

Cautions (notes only): elevated transaminase levels, especially with valproate. Monitor prior to start, at 1 month, 3 months, 6 months and as clinically indicated. Caution with driving or operating machinery due to somnolence and sedative effects. Monitor for suicidal thoughts or behaviors.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 4 months; reauthorization up to 12 months if responding positively and doses have not exceeded 20 mg/kg/day.
Quantity and dosing (notes only): 5 × 100 ml bottles (100 mg/ml); doses do not exceed 20 mg/kg/day. max_units is null; dosing and quantity are not evaluated.
Documentation verification, ongoing monitoring, cautions, duration, reauthorization, dosing and quantity enforcement require manual review; this pack remains partial.
